record.name: Papillon
record.appearance: adult woman, 30; rose-pink wavy bob, pink-violet eyes, butterfly clips, pearlescent mint-tied bikini, open cropped holographic jacket, black straps, white and pink mechanical thigh-high boots, scale wings and a lepidopter rail rifle; her completed metamorph is a nonhuman biomechanical butterfly with six articulated legs, four great scale-built wings, a compact insect head and a segmented abdomen, and it is Papillon herself, not a companion or a humanoid wearing wings

passive.name: iridescence
passive.description: Emerging from a cocoon as a human grants Papillon an 80-point barrier for 4 s (120 ticks). It triggers once per completed return, not on entering a cocoon or starting the signature.
passive.notes: Human-form passive. Papillon alternates forms (see the signature notes); the lepidopter form has its own passive, Pupal Reserve, recorded there. One protection budget: a parcel removes Papillon's copy; at R5 two 40-point parcels or one 80-point version. Parcels are not shootable and carry no hit points (hp 0 is a placeholder). Passive forms carry rules, not a skill behaviour: the draft form behaviour was removed on promotion; it recorded rank 0 trigger = "on emergence from a cocoon as a human, once per completed return" (schema cannot express a cocoon-emergence trigger (a completed return to human form; not on entering a cocoon or starting the signature); the form carries the barrier as an unconditional self effect.); rank 3 trigger = "on emergence from a cocoon as a human, once per completed return" (schema cannot express a cocoon-emergence trigger (a completed return to human form; not on entering a cocoon or starting the signature); the form carries the barrier as an unconditional self effect.); rank 3 effects[1].recipient.radius = 100 (the touch radius of a parcel is not in the proposal; 100 cm is a body-contact distance.); rank 3 budget = "one protection budget of 80 points between the self copy and the parcel" (schema cannot express a single shared protection budget: the self effect and the parcel effect are alternatives, and depositing the parcel removes Papillon's copy.); rank 5 trigger = "on emergence from a cocoon as a human, once per completed return" (schema cannot express a cocoon-emergence trigger (a completed return to human form; not on entering a cocoon or starting the signature); the form carries the barrier as an unconditional self effect.); rank 5 effects[1].recipient.radius = 100 (the touch radius of a parcel is not in the proposal; 100 cm is a body-contact distance.); rank 5 budget = "one protection budget of 80 points, either on Papillon or split into two 40-point parcels" (schema cannot express a single shared protection budget: the self effect (80) and the two 40-point parcels are alternatives; each ally claims at most one parcel.).

counterplay: Punish the targetable cocoon before the barrier exists; the barrier is a single protection budget even when parcels are left for allies.

signature.name: metamorphosis: take flight
signature.description: Close into a luminous scale cocoon for 0.9 s (27 ticks), then emerge as the flying six-legged lepidopter. The signature itself performs only the delayed form change. Her insect form persists until the next signature; its separate passive, auto attack and active replace the human kit.
signature.effect: Close into a luminous scale cocoon for 0.9 s (27 ticks), then emerge as the flying six-legged lepidopter. The signature itself performs only the delayed form change. Her insect form persists until the next signature; its separate passive, auto attack and active replace the human kit.
signature.notes: Transformation contract (skill-paradigms.md): start human. Successful signature activations 1, 3, 5... perform human, closed cocoon, flying lepidopter; activations 2, 4, 6... reverse it. R0 only transforms her after a 0.9 s (27 ticks) cocoon. Both finished forms persist until the next signature activation; there is no automatic timed reversion at any rank. The targetable cocoon retains her current health; pupation gives no heal, cleanse or invulnerability; she cannot attack or cast another skill inside it. Defeat cancels the transition; a completed transition advances the activation count. Returning to human requires a previewed legal landing point; flight stays inside supported arena space; her body stays targetable and wings do not multiply incoming damage. The signature recovers for 8 s (240 ticks) after emergence in either direction; each form's active retains its remaining cooldown while inactive; changing form resets neither attacks nor active recovery; respawn starts a new human-form cycle. All four skill slots change with form. Entities: the cocoon (papillon_chrysalis) and the lepidopter body (papillon_lepidopter) carry her hit points as an upper bound (hp 1140 is her maximum; the proposal says the cocoon retains her current health); the Husk, its R5 canopy and the Borrowed Wings perch belong to the lepidopter form and are listed here so the models stay mapped (Husk 1 hit point: one hostile primary hit shatters it; canopy 160 points, 350 cm; perch 80 hit points assumed). LEPIDOPTER FORM, recorded in full because the schema holds one kit per fighter: Passive R0 Pupal Reserve - Useful husk: Emerging as the lepidopter leaves a fragile Husk for 6 s (180 ticks). The first ally touching it releases saved scales and gains 20% movement speed for 3 s (90 ticks). One hostile primary hit shatters it. Her insect passive creates a rendezvous resource, distinct from human-form Iridescence. Passive R3 Pupal Reserve - Pick-up point: An ally can interact with the Husk to signal readiness for collection instead. When Papillon physically comes within 2 m (200 cm), that ally may accept an available Borrowed Wings perch. Using it for collection consumes the Husk and forgoes its speed burst. It never teleports the waiting ally. Passive R5 Pupal Reserve - Unfold the shelter: Order an unused Husk to open into a stationary canopy for its remaining lifetime, with a shared 160-point projectile barrier. It protects either side from shots crossing it and can be entered or walked around. Opening it consumes its collection/speed function; destroying it removes the shelter. Auto attack R0 Ocellus Script - Write with wings: Release a visible fan of six light scales, 10 damage each, up to 6 m (600 cm). The rifle is folded into the insect chassis. Three scales hitting the same enemy mark it as a Landing Light for 3 s (90 ticks); allies moving toward that visible enemy gain 10% movement speed. Each scale hits once. Auto attack R3 Ocellus Script - Return address: Aim through her surviving Husk to bend the fan once. Its full travel still fits inside 6 m (600 cm) and terrain blocks it. Hitting a Landing Light refreshes its timer, not its strength. She covers a rendezvous through a short-range wing weapon rather than reusing Scale Shot. Auto attack R5 Ocellus Script - Written escort: Select an occupied Borrowed Wings perch as the fan's origin. Scales visibly travel from wing to perch, spending part of their original range, then spread outward. This remains her one primary attack. Riders keep their own weapons and generate no additional fans. Active R0 Borrowed Wings - Carry a friend: Open one scale perch for 3 s (90 ticks). An ally within 2 m (200 cm) can voluntarily attach for up to 2 s (60 ticks), following her actual flight path and able to detach at any time. Carrying slows her flight by 25% and prevents Ocellus Script. Both remain targetable; landing or hard displacement safely dismounts the rider. Cooldown: 10 s (300 ticks). Active R3 Borrowed Wings - Pair of passengers: Open two perches and permit Ocellus Script while carrying. Each rider accepts separately and occupies a visible trailing position. Her flight leaves a brief trail granting following allies 15% movement speed for 2 s (60 ticks). The flight-speed penalty remains. The same ally cannot be collected twice per cast. Active R5 Borrowed Wings - Separate arrivals: A rider may accept a detached glide instead of staying attached. Their perch travels up to 4 m (400 cm) along a previewed route to a legal landing over one second. It remains vulnerable, cannot cross solid cover and can be interrupted. Send two allies to different lanes while Papillon takes a third. Detaching spends that perch. Signature R0 Metamorphosis: Touch Down - Even activation: Preview a legal landing, settle there, close into a cocoon for 0.9 s (27 ticks), then emerge human. A passenger dismounts beside that landing first. This is the reverse transformation: it removes the insect kit, restores the rifle kit and triggers human Iridescence after emergence. Signature R3 Metamorphosis: Touch Down - Orderly disembarkation: Before closing the cocoon, current riders can accept separate adjacent safe landing positions. They move along short physical perch paths instead of stacking on Papillon. The transformation starts after dismounting and preserves the full 0.9 s (27 ticks) vulnerable phase. Signature R5 Metamorphosis: Touch Down - Final departures: Current riders may accept their detached glides as Papillon lands and pupates. Their visible routes continue while she becomes human. The signature opens no new perches and extends no spent glide. She changes her role while the teammates she launched finish their own approaches.

dossier.selectionRationale: The 2026-11-07 dossier proposals (docs/dossier-proposals/2026-11-07) make Papillon an operator: a ribbon-routed rifle and an alternating insect body that carries the team, distinct from fable's preventative sustain and echo's tempo support. The alternating human, cocoon and lepidopter forms are owner direction; each form keeps its own passive, auto attack, active and signature.
dossier.weaponConcept: lepidopter rail rifle (high-velocity photonic rail rifle with adaptive butterfly stabilizers that converts light into condensed scales; folding wing stabilizers, nano-photonic scale magazine, butterfly charm tuning focus and a modular frame), folded into the insect chassis in lepidopter form
dossier.loreStatus: draft lore composed from the supplied dossier sheet and the 2026-11-07 proposals; not owner-reviewed

lore.backstory: Papillon flies the quiet routes between sectors. The rifle folds into wings, a cocoon closes around her, and the insect body that comes out ferries friends over ruins. She treats every lane as a route someone else will follow.
lore.syndicateRecord: Listed as a courier of unregistered routes; the supplied sheet records no affiliation and no charges.
lore.psychProfile: Warm, loose and route-minded: she plans arrivals for the team before her own, and gives up her rifle for wings when the lane needs a carrier.

progression.numericPolicy: Authored channels define numeric values; descriptions define transformations. Preserve source rounding and record discrepancies.

passive.stock: Emerging from a cocoon as a human grants Papillon an 80-point barrier for 4 s (120 ticks). It triggers once per completed return, not on entering a cocoon or starting the signature.
passive.interpretation: Numbers are the prototype values of the 2026-11-07 proposal; rank descriptions specify behavior. Geometry is the authored illustration profile, not an executable collision bake.
counterplay: Punish the targetable cocoon before the barrier exists; the barrier is a single protection budget even when parcels are left for allies.

forms.name: iridescence
forms.description: Emerging from a cocoon as a human grants Papillon an 80-point barrier for 4 s (120 ticks). It triggers once per completed return, not on entering a cocoon or starting the signature.

forms.name: leave the landing light on
forms.description: On emergence, wear the 80-point barrier or leave it as a bright scale parcel at a surviving Wingstep ribbon's exit. The first ally touching it claims its remaining barrier and duration. Depositing it removes Papillon's copy; there is one protection budget.

forms.name: distributed arrival
forms.description: With two surviving ribbon exits, split that same budget into two 40-point parcels, or retain one 80-point version. Each ally can claim only one parcel from that return. Prepare two safe arrivals without creating extra shield value.

interactionPolicy.sourceAmbiguities: These explicit loop guards and committed-leap semantics are curation decisions, not observed gameplay.

basic.stock: Fire an 80-damage scale round up to 11 m (1100 cm). A round deliberately aimed into her Wingstep ribbon's entrance follows the ribbon, then exits along its final tangent. It spends the same 11 m (1100 cm) total travel budget, collides with terrain throughout and hits the first enemy. A dash can draw a firing route around an open corner.
basic.interpretation: Numbers are the prototype values of the 2026-11-07 proposal; rank descriptions specify behavior. Geometry is the authored illustration profile, not an executable collision bake.
counterplay: Break ribbon entrances, contest landing spaces and sidestep: the routed round is a visible physical projectile that collides with terrain throughout.

forms.name: scale shot
forms.description: Fire an 80-damage scale round up to 11 m (1100 cm). A round deliberately aimed into her Wingstep ribbon's entrance follows the ribbon, then exits along its final tangent. It spends the same 11 m (1100 cm) total travel budget, collides with terrain throughout and hits the first enemy. A dash can draw a firing route around an open corner.

forms.name: shared barrel
forms.description: Allies can deliberately aim basic, nonexplosive projectiles into the entrance too. Routed allied shots retain 80% of their original damage, original ownership and total range budget. Beams, melee attacks, explosives and signatures cannot ride the route. The shooter's aim chooses whether to use it.

forms.name: opposite readings
forms.description: On a closed connected route, split her own round into two 40-damage packets traveling in opposite directions. Both are visible physical projectiles. One victim takes at most the original 80 damage from that firing. The split never duplicates allied ammunition.

payloadUnits.statusAmount: percentage points unless a state definition specifies otherwise

basic.windupPolicy: The proposal does not specify basic windup; the roster operator and bastion basics supply it (hypothesis recorded on each form).

active.stock: Dash 4 m (400 cm), leaving one directional photonic ribbon for 6 s (180 ticks). A new human-form ribbon replaces the old one. It routes Scale Shot but is neither wall nor teleport. Cooldown: 8 s (240 ticks).
active.interpretation: Numbers are the prototype values of the 2026-11-07 proposal; rank descriptions specify behavior. Geometry is the authored illustration profile, not an executable collision bake.
counterplay: Destroy the visible ribbon entrance node; the ribbon is neither wall nor teleport.

forms.name: wingstep
forms.description: Dash 4 m (400 cm), leaving one directional photonic ribbon for 6 s (180 ticks). A new human-form ribbon replaces the old one. It routes Scale Shot but is neither wall nor teleport. Cooldown: 8 s (240 ticks).

forms.name: a path with teeth
forms.description: Shed slowing scales along the ribbon. Enemies crossing it are slowed 30% for 2 s (60 ticks), once per ribbon. Allies crossing forward gain 15% movement speed for 2 s (60 ticks). Destroying the visible entrance node ends the route and its crossing effects.

forms.name: two strokes
forms.description: Gain two charges, each recovering in 8 s (240 ticks). Two ribbons may coexist and connect at meeting endpoints. Draw an escape fork, a bent firing route or a loop for Opposite Readings. Connecting them refreshes neither lifetime nor projectile range.

payloadUnits.damage: points per hit or pulse; sequence describes splitting
payloadUnits.statusAmount: percentage points unless a state definition specifies otherwise

signature.stock: Close into a luminous scale cocoon for 0.9 s (27 ticks), then emerge as the flying six-legged lepidopter. The signature itself performs only the delayed form change. Her insect form persists until the next signature; its separate passive, auto attack and active replace the human kit.
signature.interpretation: Numbers are the prototype values of the 2026-11-07 proposal; rank descriptions specify behavior. Geometry is the authored illustration profile, not an executable collision bake.
counterplay: Punish the targetable cocoon: it retains her current health and she cannot act inside it.
Slow, visible transport routes let opponents intercept the courier; break ribbon entrances and Husks and contest landing spaces.

forms.name: metamorphosis: take flight
forms.description: Close into a luminous scale cocoon for 0.9 s (27 ticks), then emerge as the flying six-legged lepidopter. The signature itself performs only the delayed form change. Her insect form persists until the next signature; its separate passive, auto attack and active replace the human kit.

forms.name: carry the drawing
forms.description: Complete the same delayed transformation, preserving existing Wingstep ribbons for their remaining lifetime. The lepidopter can use a surviving entrance as a rendezvous for Borrowed Wings. Transformation refreshes no ribbon and instantly relocates no ally.

forms.name: running pupation
forms.description: Commit the signature during Wingstep. The closed, targetable cocoon slides along the unused portion of that already committed 4 m (400 cm) dash, opening when its usual 0.9 s (27 ticks) timer ends. The launch adds no distance and preserves the vulnerable intermediary.

identity.name: Papillon
identity.appearance: adult woman, 30; rose-pink wavy bob, pink-violet eyes, butterfly clips, pearlescent mint-tied bikini, open cropped holographic jacket, black straps, white and pink mechanical thigh-high boots, scale wings and a lepidopter rail rifle; her completed metamorph is a nonhuman biomechanical butterfly with six articulated legs, four great scale-built wings, a compact insect head and a segmented abdomen, and it is Papillon herself, not a companion or a humanoid wearing wings

notes: User-supplied operative design recorded in papillon.png.
The source sheet presents a striker concept and depicts lepidopter rail rifle. These are source labels, not normalized gameplay contracts.

Transparent v3 portraits, form studies and prototype R0/R3/R5 descriptions are recorded in docs/dossier-proposals/2026-11-07/README.md; these remain design proposals rather than executable kit definitions.
Owner direction: signature activations alternate human -> cocoon -> nonhuman flying lepidopter and back; each persistent form has its own four-slot kit.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Passive R0 Pupal Reserve - Useful husk: Emerging as the lepidopter leaves a fragile Husk for 6 s (180 ticks). The first ally touching it releases saved scales and gains 20% movement speed for 3 s (90 ticks). One hostile primary hit shatters it. Her insect passive creates a rendezvous resource, distinct from human-form Iridescence.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Passive R3 Pupal Reserve - Pick-up point: An ally can interact with the Husk to signal readiness for collection instead. When Papillon physically comes within 2 m (200 cm), that ally may accept an available Borrowed Wings perch. Using it for collection consumes the Husk and forgoes its speed burst. It never teleports the waiting ally.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Passive R5 Pupal Reserve - Unfold the shelter: Order an unused Husk to open into a stationary canopy for its remaining lifetime, with a shared 160-point projectile barrier. It protects either side from shots crossing it and can be entered or walked around. Opening it consumes its collection/speed function; destroying it removes the shelter.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Auto attack R0 Ocellus Script - Write with wings: Release a visible fan of six light scales, 10 damage each, up to 6 m (600 cm). The rifle is folded into the insect chassis. Three scales hitting the same enemy mark it as a Landing Light for 3 s (90 ticks); allies moving toward that visible enemy gain 10% movement speed. Each scale hits once.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Auto attack R3 Ocellus Script - Return address: Aim through her surviving Husk to bend the fan once. Its full travel still fits inside 6 m (600 cm) and terrain blocks it. Hitting a Landing Light refreshes its timer, not its strength. She covers a rendezvous through a short-range wing weapon rather than reusing Scale Shot.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Auto attack R5 Ocellus Script - Written escort: Select an occupied Borrowed Wings perch as the fan's origin. Scales visibly travel from wing to perch, spending part of their original range, then spread outward. This remains her one primary attack. Riders keep their own weapons and generate no additional fans.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Active R0 Borrowed Wings - Carry a friend: Open one scale perch for 3 s (90 ticks). An ally within 2 m (200 cm) can voluntarily attach for up to 2 s (60 ticks), following her actual flight path and able to detach at any time. Carrying slows her flight by 25% and prevents Ocellus Script. Both remain targetable; landing or hard displacement safely dismounts the rider. Cooldown: 10 s (300 ticks).

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Active R3 Borrowed Wings - Pair of passengers: Open two perches and permit Ocellus Script while carrying. Each rider accepts separately and occupies a visible trailing position. Her flight leaves a brief trail granting following allies 15% movement speed for 2 s (60 ticks). The flight-speed penalty remains. The same ally cannot be collected twice per cast.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Active R5 Borrowed Wings - Separate arrivals: A rider may accept a detached glide instead of staying attached. Their perch travels up to 4 m (400 cm) along a previewed route to a legal landing over one second. It remains vulnerable, cannot cross solid cover and can be interrupted. Send two allies to different lanes while Papillon takes a third. Detaching spends that perch.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Signature R0 Metamorphosis: Touch Down - Even activation: Preview a legal landing, settle there, close into a cocoon for 0.9 s (27 ticks), then emerge human. A passenger dismounts beside that landing first. This is the reverse transformation: it removes the insect kit, restores the rifle kit and triggers human Iridescence after emergence.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Signature R3 Metamorphosis: Touch Down - Orderly disembarkation: Before closing the cocoon, current riders can accept separate adjacent safe landing positions. They move along short physical perch paths instead of stacking on Papillon. The transformation starts after dismounting and preserves the full 0.9 s (27 ticks) vulnerable phase.

Lepidopter form (recorded so nothing is lost; the schema holds one kit per fighter, see skills/signature.json notes): Signature R5 Metamorphosis: Touch Down - Final departures: Current riders may accept their detached glides as Papillon lands and pupates. Their visible routes continue while she becomes human. The signature opens no new perches and extends no spent glide. She changes her role while the teammates she launched finish their own approaches.

iconFamily.subject: a bold butterfly trailing a single chunky scale-light streak
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Papillon. Theme: lepidopter. Subject: a bold butterfly trailing a single chunky scale-light streak. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
